name: WordPress.com
steps: Open the post or page you want the game on and select the block inserter (+).
Search for HTML and choose the Custom HTML block.
Select Edit HTML if the block shows a preview, paste the code and select Update (or Publish).
Open the live page, not the editor preview, to check the game and the credit line under it.
If the code is gone after saving, your plan strips scripts: see the note below, then use the plain frame code or a link to the game page.
limits: Scripts and frames are kept only on a paid plan with hosting features active (the help page says a paid plan alone is not enough). On the free plan they are removed when you save, so link to the game page with a normal link instead. Self-hosted WordPress.org uses the same block name, but its rules were not verified from official documentation: check in your editor.

name: Wix
steps: In the editor choose Add Elements → Embed Code → Embed HTML.
Click Enter Code, paste the code and press Apply.
Set the element width and height to 100% so the game is not cropped.
Publish the site and open it over https to see the game.
limits: Only HTTPS addresses show once published.

name: Squarespace
steps: Edit the page and add a Code block (or an Embed block with a code snippet).
In the Code block set the mode to HTML and paste the code.
Save, then open the page in a private window to check it.
limits: Code blocks need a Core, Plus or Advanced plan; Embed blocks are on all plans. Code can be hidden while you are logged in, so test in a private window.

name: Google Sites
steps: Open the page in the desktop editor.
Choose Insert → Embed → Embed code.
Paste the code, press Next, then Insert.
Click Publish: the game only shows on the published site.
limits: JavaScript must sit inside script tags. Desktop editor only.

name: Carrd
steps: Add an Embed element to the page.
Set Type to Code and Style to Inline.
Paste the code and publish the site.
limits: Needs Pro Standard or higher. Nothing shows in the builder; publish to see it.

name: Notion
steps: On your Notion page type /embed and pick Embed.
Paste the game address (the https://… link from the builder's frame code, the src value).
Press Embed link and drag the corner to resize.
limits: Notion takes an address only: no script, no pasted frame code, so no credit line is written. Add a normal link to the game page as a fallback.

name: Webflow
steps: Add a Code Embed element inside a container.
Paste the code (leave out html, body and head tags).
Preview, then publish.
limits: Needs a paid site plan. Read from help-center snippets: check in your editor.

name: Ghost
steps: In the post editor type /html or add an HTML card.
Paste the code.
Publish and check the live page: the editor only shows a placeholder.
limits: Whether scripts run is not stated on the official page: check in your editor, and use the plain frame if the script is removed.

name: Shopify, Blogger, Weebly
steps: Shopify: add a Custom Liquid or Custom HTML section.
Blogger: add an HTML/JavaScript gadget.
Weebly: drag in an Embed Code element.
Paste the code and publish.
limits: Steps and limits could not be confirmed from the official pages: check in your editor.
